title: ICML 2027 Changes [D]
summary: Just read the ICML 2027 CFP and it looks like they’re trying to tackle the submission explosion in a reasonable way. Under the new two-stage process, the area chair decides whether a paper goes to full review, and any proposed first-stage rejection has to be confirmed by a senior
reason: Reddit discussion of ICML 2027 CFP submission-process changes. No named model release (1-1), no paper/preprint/benchmark artifact (2-1), no business event (3-1), no government policy action (4-1), no OSS tool release (5-1). No rule covers it.
